$comment: How ticfac gets cloud/sandbox. ticks owns the sandbox image's build context (its internal/sandbox suite runs those scripts); this tree is ticfac's vendored copy, the embedded image context the factory deploys (embedded.go's sandboxFS). It is pinned the way contracts/ is (CONTRACTS.md): `ref` is the immutable ticks commit whose cloud/sandbox tree the vendored bytes are — the last commit that changed the tree, so a later ticks commit that does not touch it moves nothing this pin claims — and `digests` plus `modes` record the whole tree, bytes and git exec bits together. `go run ./cmd/sandbox check` verifies all of it offline on every test run; CI's verify-upstream fetches ticks at `ref` and compares byte for byte. Two repositories carrying one tree with no check between them is how the shipped image diverges from the tested one. Never edit a file under cloud/sandbox here: change it in ticks, move `ref`, and run `go run ./cmd/sandbox sync`, then commit cloud/sandbox and this file together.
